name: purchase-order
title: Purchase order working copy
for_each: select id,number from purchase_orders order by number

sections.title: Order details
sections.sql: select p.number,p.customer_order,v.name supplier,p.currency,p.placed_on,p.delivery_due,p.evidence from purchase_orders p join vendors v on v.id=p.vendor_id where p.id=$1
sections.note: Internal working copy. No supplier transmission or payment instruction.

sections.title: Items
sections.sql: select vendor_sku,name,quantity,shipped,outstanding,unit_cost_cents,currency,promise_on from v_balances where po_id=$1 order by source_id

name: supplier-review
title: Supplier review pack
for_each: select id,name from vendors order by name

sections.title: Owner and evidence
sections.sql: select name,owner,evidence from vendors where id=$1

sections.title: Open commitments
sections.sql: select b.number,b.source_id,b.name,b.outstanding,b.promise_on,b.late from v_balances b join purchase_orders p on p.id=b.po_id where p.vendor_id=$1 and b.outstanding>0 order by b.number

name: return-case
title: Return review record
for_each: select id,reference from returns order by reference

sections.title: Recorded case
sections.sql: select r.reference,b.number,b.vendor,r.quantity,r.reason,r.review_due,r.outcome,r.resolved_on from returns r join v_balances b on b.id=r.item_id where r.id=$1
sections.note: A recorded outcome does not issue a refund or determine consumer rights.
